name: Uchita (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Uchita town emblem in white: a ring crossed by winged horizontal bars enclosing a stylised character.
history: Flag of the former town of Uchita in Wakayama Prefecture, dissolved on 2005-11-07.

features.role: Uchita town emblem — a ring crossed by winged horizontal bars enclosing a stylised character
